title: Projects
text:
These projects presents an end-to-end data analysis performed in R, focusing on exploratory data analysis, statistical modeling, and data visualization.
Find a variety of projects below.




Data Wrangling: Processed and cleaned datasets using tidyverse.
Statistical Modeling: Conducted regression analysis and hypothesis testing to evaluate key variables.
Visualizations: Created custom data charts using ggplot2.


📄 Open / Download Full PDF Report





This project analyses the operational, financial, and service delivery performance of water service providers in Kenya, with particular attention to non-revenue water (NRW).
Using statistical methods in R, the study examines the distribution of NRW, its relationships with selected operational and financial indicators, and differences between compliant and non-compliant water service providers.




Descriptive statistics
Data quality assessment
Data visualisation using ggplot2
Pearson correlation analysis
Wilcoxon rank-sum test
